title: Script return hook
summary: Recover 0x4f5680: dispatch the return event, inspect the current closure and hook mask, drain the current frame's tail-call counter with event 4 callbacks, and preserve result, top and frame-limit offsets across stack relocation. The caller at 0x4f57a0 uses the returned result pointer. Dispatch and stack resize remain explicit helper bindings.
test_description: Direct GCC i386 original/source comparisons exercise closure byte, hook mask, hook presence and enable flag, counters 0 through 3, callback changes to mask and frame, and 160/161-byte free-space boundary with moving and in-place allocation. A callback can also force growth in the tail-event phase. Compare returned pointer, entire state, frames, stack buffers, allocator globals, callback records and temporary limits; verify FS restoration after original calls. Local oracle harness passed and implementation compiled with supplied MSVC under O1, O2 and O2 /Oy-.
known_limits: Readable nonmatching recovery; member method has explicit dispatch and resize bindings rather than the original ECX/EDX entry ABI.
The callback record's opaque bytes are uninitialized in the original; only event, argument and frame index are identified.

Resize and dispatch are external dependencies. Tests use accepted original helpers and a controlled successful allocator; allocation failure, exceptions, nonlocal exits and actual runtime services are not tested.
Requires original 32-bit pointer layout and valid closure, frame and stack objects. Negative or very large tail-call counts and malformed callback state are not exhaustively exercised.
